draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.96, the 160th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 20th of 30 at LB. He went 90th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (160th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (5th percentile), three-cone (19th percentile). College production: 95 tackles in 2022, 5th of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys. 19 career games and 17 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2024. Weak spots: missed tackle rate 15.2% (7th percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 off-ball linebacker who played: 28 combined tackles against a median of 40, below the norm.
